headline: NG++ 0.1.11 preserves weapon experience across new games and challenge mode
summary: The NG++ mod's 0.1.11 release keeps weapon experience when starting a new game or challenge mode. Experience-earned upgrades on the weapon in hand now use the game's own animation, followed by its popup and message.
highlights: RYNO Ammo Drops would let random ammo crates supply R.Y.N.O. ammunition once the weapon is owned. Its submission and listing pull request remain open (#215, #216).
Auto Head Gear v1.0.0 awaits listing. It applies owned Sonic Summoner and O2 Mask effects without equipping them, covering sand mice, Blarg gas vents and Rilgar's extermibots and extermitanks (#218).
Bolt Multiplier 0.3.1, Expanded Quick Select 1.0.2 and Weapon Wheel Pause 1.0.3 await review before players receive those external native-mod updates (#219, #220, #221).
An index build failure was reported and the issue closed. The report says the last good index stayed live (#217).
